message: Open CodeRabbit thread, still unresolved at 6cbafcb8 (Minor; the script is byte-identical to 9732ee32): planContiguousVerified accepts a short head_sha (box probe: 'abcd1234' lands in plan.land). Downstream compares fail closed, so the result is a false STOP that needs a stop-ack, not a false pass. Follow-up: assert isFullSha(entry.head_sha) when the plan is built.

F5 continuity still holds only when --prior is passed. --prior is optional on plan/readback/readback-run/stop-ack, and verify-log against the stale plan-time digest still reports ok/appended after a false->true flip (box probe). The single-merge readback example at :267 omits --prior/--digest-out, while land skill step 12 (now with the B1 record-on-every-exit text) and runbook steps 3 and 5 include them. Follow-up: make the doc example consistent, or require --prior once a digest exists.

Architect follow-ups F6 (cached passing row not re-checked against main), F8 (formula-escape compare on verdict_ref) and F9 (free-text stop-ack --by) are still open, as the PR scope states. Architect N1-N5 are also still open and non-blocking. All fail closed or are info-level.

Step 12 says a refusal writes no digest. That is exact for readback, the command step 12 runs (box probe: no --digest-out file on a refusal). readback-run, though, writes --digest-out on a refusal too (scripts/merge-readback.mjs:718-723). The value equals the prior digest and no row is appended (box probe), so the recorded digest stays correct. This is a wording nuance only.

Carried from r4. Under the F2 amendment, an empty squash whose PR change already landed on main identically passes as rebased-tree-matches. The content on main equals the verified intent, and Architect accepted this in the delta gate.
